messages.author: 2a3a0c6a456f3043
messages.subject: Autoreg in pcountOpen
parts:
Hi all,

I am using an autoregressive Dail-Madsen model via the pcountOpen function with dynamics = 'autoreg'. I am trying to figure out exactly what the function is doing when the autoregressive dynamics are specified but am having trouble figuring it out from the unmarked code. I know vaguely from the help document that it is "an auto-regressive model in whcih recruitment is modeled as gamma*N[i,t-1]". Maybe that's enough, but I would like to see how it's coded in unmarked if possible. I ran 'pcountOpen' in R to see the code, but can't seem to find what it's doing with the 'autoreg' argument. After most of the error checking with if(identical) statements, there is a switch function: gamName <- switch(dynamics......), that renames 'autoreg' to gamAR stored within ganName. After that, I don't see what's done with it. I'm not sure if it is handled within nLL or the optim function or unmarkedEstimate or somewhere else. I understand what most of the code is doing but can't seem to figure out this one piece.

I'm interested for two reasons, 1) to understand exactly what I'm doing, and 2) so I might code a Bayesian equivalent in JAGS.

I assume that in BUGS language (including JAGS) recruitment would be something like:
Recruit[i] ~ dpois(gamma[i] * N[i, t-1])
log(gamma[i]) <- alpha + beta1*X1[i]

Although, I guess I would have to think about how to handle t-1 in the for loop. Any help or advice on where to look in the unmarked code would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Dan

messages.author: df74d6fccec2ff7e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Autoreg in pcountOpen
parts:
Hi Dan,

This model is discussed in the original paper by Dail and Madsen, and you are correct that it simply models the expected number of recruits at time t as gamma*N(i,t-1). So if N(i,t-1) is 10 and gamma is 2, then you would expect 20 new individuals to enter the population. 

If you really want to see the code, it is in C++ here: https://github.com/rbchan/unmarked/blob/master/src/nll_pcountOpen.cpp . 

There is some code to fit the model using BUGS here: https://sites.google.com/site/unmarkedinfo/home/workshops/patux2012/r-scripts/script-dail-madsen.R?attredirects=0&d=1 

Richard
